import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import PayQrCode from '@src/img/views/PayQrCode';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { cancelBackendSponsorPayment, getBackendSponsorPayment } from '@src/api/bot/sponsor-payment';

import { getSponsorPayData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/sponsor/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { renderCachedImage } from '@src/utils/imageRender';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 10 * 1000;
const TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

const buildSuccessContent = () => {
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText('✅ 赞助成功！');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();

  md.addText('订单已由服务端完成结算，请查看VIP状态与主题权限。');

  return md;
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const result = await getSponsorPayData(String(e.UserId), e.MessageText, isPrivate, createBackendRequestContext(e));

    if (result.code === 'PRIVATE_ONLY') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 赞助购买仅支持私聊操作');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赞助购买', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'INVALID_FORMAT') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText('格式：/赞助购买 <整数金额>');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赞助购买', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'ORDER_FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText(`❌ ${result.error}`);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赞助购买', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const { uid, orderNo, qrCodeBuffer, packageName, yuan } = result;
    const qrCodeDataUrl = `data:image/png;base64,${qrCodeBuffer.toString('base64')}`;
    const payImg = await renderCachedImage(PayQrCode, { qrCodeDataUrl, packageName, yuan, orderNo, theme: 'default' }, 'panel:sponsor:pay');

    if (!payImg || typeof payImg === 'boolean') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 支付页面渲染失败，请稍后重试');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赞助购买', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const payFormat = Format.create();

    payFormat.addImage(payImg);
    void message.send({ format: payFormat });

    let pollCount = 0;
    const maxPolls = Math.ceil(TIMEOUT_MS / POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
    const processing = false;

    const pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
      pollCount++;

      void (async () => {
        if (processing) {
          return;
        }

        try {
          const status = (await getBackendSponsorPayment(String(e.UserId), uid, orderNo)).status;

          if (status === 'SUCCESS') {
            clearInterval(pollTimer);
            const md = buildSuccessContent();

            void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赞助成功', content: md }));

            return;
          }

          if (status !== 'PENDING' && status !== 'PAID') {
            clearInterval(pollTimer);

            return;
          }

          if (pollCount >= maxPolls) {
            clearInterval(pollTimer);
            await cancelBackendSponsorPayment(String(e.UserId), uid, orderNo, createBackendRequestContext(e));
            const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText('⏰ 支付超时（5分钟），订单已取消。\n如已支付请联系客服处理。');

            void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赞助购买', content: md }));
          }
        } catch (err) {
          logger.error(`[SponsorPay] 轮询支付状态异常: orderNo=${orderNo}`, err);
        }
      })();
    }, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
  } catch (err) {
    logger.error('[SponsorPay] 赞助购买异常', err);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 赞助购买异常，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赞助购买', content: md }));
  }
});
